_doc: The Lift 3 crash site (lift3_crash_site, DESIGN §1 and §11): the Program lift #4471 came in on, down short of the drop. The wreck itself reuses the Cordon transport's props (data/props/wild4_plane.json). The supply canister is the Program's drop canister (models/items/supply_canister.glb, tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/items.py, the model SupplyDrops lands under a chute) stood in the dirt as a prop: these came off the rack in the crash with their chutes still packed. Until `make assets` it stands in as a box.

defs.name: Unopened Supply Canister
defs.description: An olive Program drop canister driven nose-first into the dirt, its chute pack still strapped shut on the lid and the stencil scuffed: it came off the rack in the crash and never dropped.
